study type: Predictive modeling with retrospective cohort study
exposure: Well-established factors associated with cessation of exclusive breastfeeding
Factors associated with complications during pregnancy and delivery
outcome: Cessation of exclusive breastfeeding within one month
cohort: The study included 110,206 infants and 106,835 mothers from a nationwide Danish dataset, with infants born between January 1, 2014, and December 31, 2015, after 35 weeks gestation.
finding: The developed machine learning models could not accurately predict the cessation of exclusive breastfeeding within one month among infants born after 35 weeks gestation, and including additional factors did not improve model performance.
mod_finding: Delivery mode was identified as one of the most important factors influencing the overall performance of both predictive models.
